item.title: James Ellis Ford made his new album from a hospital room
item.description: James Ellis Ford's new album Lost In Another World tells a story of survival and imagination. He made it from his hospital room during cancer treatment.

item.title: Sailor circumnavigating the Arctic forced to go home
item.description: Matt Rutherford set out to be the first person to circumnavigate the Arctic Ocean solo. He says he was force to abandon the journey after the Russian government turned him around.

item.title: Lake Powell and Lake Mead water levels hit record lows
item.description: The water levels of Lakes Powell and Mead are at record lows. What does that mean for the millions of people who rely on the country's two biggest reservoirs and the Colorado River that feeds them?

item.title: Hurricane Lala strengthens as it heads to Hawaii
item.description: Hurricane Lala is headed toward Hawaii's Big Island. If it makes landfall there, it'd be the first hurricane to do so since 1871.

item.title: They fought for the U.S. in Afghanistan. Now they worry about losing their green cards
item.description: When the U.S. withdrew from Afghanistan five years ago, thousands of Afghans who helped U.S. troops were brought here to rebuild their lives. But now, some fear the U.S. may want to send them back.
